title: Senior Digital Design Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for building entirely new solutions? As part of our Digital Design team, you’ll take imaginative ideas and turn them into reality. 

 Responsibilities 
 Micro-architecture definition for efficient and power-optimized architectures
RTL development using System Verilog, or Verilog, VHDL Low-power design (UPF) Lint, CDC/RDC Synthesis constraining
Soft and hard IP identification, selection and integration
Collaboration with verification team in verification plan development and debug
Collaboration with backend team to close the design on timing and power 

 Minimum Qualification 
 B.S. or M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science with min. 4 years of experience in digital design
Strong communication and presentation skills Proactive mindset, strong problem solving skills, ability to work autonomously Knowledge of RTL design
Knowledge of Testbench development
Knowledge of System Verilog and VHDL, Verilog 

 Preferred Qualification 
 Knowledge of mixed signal concepts
Experience in data path development
Experience in SoC architectures incl. CPU (ARM), Memory and Peripheral Subsystems
Experience with Synthesis, Timing Closure Experience with Power Analysis and Optimization Experience in Formal Verification Methodology Experience in advanced Functional Verification Mythologies, i.e. UVM, Coverage modeling xperience with scripting languages (TCL, Python, Perl, Shell-scripting) 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
Designs advanced digital and mixed-signal IPs and integrates on SoC for RF CMOS, high-speed data communication, data acquisition and low-power & low-voltage applications.

Key Skills: TCL,Functional Verification,Shell scripting,Data,Synthesis,System verilog,Formal Verification,RTL design
